resolution.plan: The vanilla-LLM prompt is shown only as Figure 2 examples ('In the table below, one cell is marked as [MISSING], please predict its value and answer using JSON: {value, confidence}') and the 11 benchmark test sets (ID held-out tables from five training sources plus six OOD sources) are released with the code. Take the template and test files from the repository, run o4-mini (single snapshot 2025-04-16) with verbalized confidence, compute R@P=0.9 per dataset with the footnote-6 tie rule, and compare the 11-dataset mean with 0.56 (Table 2).
